name: Does green building qualify for rebates or incentives?

mainEntity.name: Does green building qualify for rebates or incentives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, federal tax credits (30% solar, heat pumps), utility rebates, local PACE financing, and property tax exemptions often offset 20-50% of green upgrade costs.
